source_title: Medicare Part D IPM: Program Background
captured_source_scope: Medicare Part D IPM program background page, page last modified Jan. 15, 2026
captured_methodology_summary: CMS states that validation findings are applied to a randomly selected 5% sample of the Part D beneficiary population, then CMS calculates estimated payment error for that sample and extrapolates it onto payments of remaining Part D beneficiaries to determine the gross payment error amount and national Part D IPM.

source_title: Part D Improper Payment Measurement (Part D IPM): Fiscal Year 2024 Error Rate Findings and Results
captured_source_scope: FY2024 Part D IPM findings PDF, findings on overpayments and underpayments
captured_methodology_summary: CMS states that an overpayment error occurs when corrected gross drug cost is less than the gross drug cost on the PDE record and an underpayment occurs when corrected gross drug cost is more than the PDE record. CMS lists FY2024 overpayment categories as drug or drug pricing discrepancies and insufficient documentation, and the FY2024 underpayment category as drug or drug pricing discrepancies. This supports overpayment and underpayment split review but does not establish unknown-payment treatment.
